issue.body:
Hey,
I've been working on setting the cookie in a response, and it worked, but I noticed in my javascript console that it had a warning saying that samesite was set to none. I remember the doc said it was to default to lax, but for whatever reason that wasn't working. No biggie I though, I'll just manually set it. When I go to set the samesite value I get an error despite it listing it as an option.

This is what I'm doing but it gives me an error. Removing samesite works.
`response.set_cookie("Test Token", "Some value", max_age=None, expires=None, path="/", domain=None, secure=False, httponly=False, samesite="lax")`
issue.title: set_cookie samesite
